items.title: SIIM-CAIMI: AI triaging for ICH leads to faster turnaround times
items.excerpt: A multisite University of Washington study of an AI intracranial hemorrhage triage system found 79.3% sensitivity and 94.2% specificity; median report turnaround for ICH-positive head CTs fell from 214 to 201 minutes and AI-flagged patients reached admission sooner.

items.title: ChatGPT-5 misses half of distal radius fractures on x-rays
items.excerpt: Rambam Health Care Campus researchers (Emergency Radiology, Oct 26) found ChatGPT-5 had 51.2% sensitivity and 61.6% accuracy on 370 wrist x-rays, missing 83 of 170 distal radius fractures.

items.title: SIIM-CAIMI: Apollo LLM framework shows promise in patient monitoring
items.excerpt: Apollo, a multimodal temporal foundation model from Faisal Mahmood's Harvard/Brigham team trained on 25 billion records from 7.2 million Mass General Brigham patients, outperformed 26 clinical risk scores (AUC 0.79 vs 0.64 for five-year breast cancer metastasis).

items.excerpt: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into clinical medical imaging has advanced diagnostics but also poses challenges in maintaining long-term reliability as input data change. items.title: AI May Help Detect Rare Sperm in Men With Azoospermia
items.excerpt: An AI system that scans testicular tissue samples for rare sperm in men with azoospermia was presented at ASRM 2026; researchers said it has already resulted in three live births.

items.title: Changes in Service Use Following the Introduction of AI-Enabled Prior Authorization in Medicare
items.excerpt: A JAMA research letter uses Epic Cosmos data to assess how Medicare beneficiaries' use of medical services changed after CMS's WISeR model introduced AI-enabled prior authorization for 41 services starting January 2026.

items.title: UT Austin unveils UT Dell Medicine as it bets big on new AI-native hospital
items.excerpt: UT Austin unveiled UT Dell Medicine, a unified academic health system combining its clinics, Dell Medical School and the upcoming UT Dell Medical Center, which it is building as an AI-native hospital.

items.title: UnitedHealthcare expands AI companion Avery to 21M members
items.excerpt: UnitedHealthcare is expanding Avery, its generative AI companion for care coordination, to 21 million members.

items.title: Radiology societies weigh in on FDA’s push to regulate generative AI
items.excerpt: RSNA and other radiology societies filed comments on the FDA's push to regulate generative AI devices: patient safety should stay central and regulatory flexibility should come with clear, enforceable safeguards.

items.title: Researchers develop way of adapting adult radiology AI models to pediatric population
items.excerpt: Researchers developed a method for adapting adult radiology AI models to children; only about 17% of FDA-authorized AI devices are currently labeled for pediatric use.

items.title: Clinicians from all specialties use AI to answer cardiology questions
items.excerpt: Overall, more than 950,000 clinicians submitted queries to a popular AI platform from January 2024 to June 2026. Cardiovascular care was a common topic, especially questions about specific treatments and medications.
